description: Read one Wikidata item by Q-id: labels in de/fr/it/rm/en, description, the key statements with values resolved to labels (instance of, country, located in, coordinates, population, area, elevation, website, inception, headquarters, industry, …; up to max_properties), Swiss identifiers (BFS municipality code P771, HLS/DHS id P902, parliament id P1307), and de/fr/it/rm/en Wikipedia links. Examples: 'Q72' (Zürich), 'Q1374' (Matterhorn), 'Q11943' (ETH Zürich).

id.description: Wikidata Q-id, e.g. 'Q72', or an entity URI

language.description: Language for resolved value labels (default en)

name: get_wikidata_entity
title: Wikidata entity details
